'''Brightwood Grove''' is an area in [[Duskwood]]. The few buildings that stood at the edge of the grove lie in ruins and [[Nightbane pack|Nightbane]] [[worgen]] prowl the dark fields, erecting crude camps and hungrily attacking anyone who come too close. Young [[Alliance]]-based adventurers are often sent here to slay some of the wolf men to better control their numbers. The location is just west of [[Darkshire]].
